# Asia Open: Supply Tight, Prices Rising Fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter sourcing and higher pricing; lock in volume now for most high‑risk logic parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk slipped marginally to **71.1** (‑0.2) while price trend eased to **86.2** (‑0.4) but remains “Rising fast” [1][2].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged +56 % YoY through Oct 2026, pushing supply risk higher across advanced logic [3].  
- Korea’s chip‑led exports jumped +100 % YoY in early Nov 2026, reinforcing both supply tightness and price pressure [4].  
- Semiconductor PPI rose +32.6 % annualized over the last three months, the top driver of price escalation [1].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,071** units, giving ~17.6 weeks of channel coverage.  
- Price **$5.56** / unit (qty 1) and **$2.51** / unit (1 k).  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- **Buy‑timing call:** *Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)* – 73 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fixing price now avoids later hikes while keeping normal order cadence.

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Elevated** (70.0, –0.2), **Rising** (83.8), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Rising** (68.8, –0.2), **Rising** (75.8), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – **Rising** (66.9, –0.2), **Rising** (82.2), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Rising** (67.7, –0.1), **Rising** (79.8), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – **Rising** (66.7, –0.2), **Rising** (80.7), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
1. **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time **52 weeks** vs ~12 weeks norm; supply risk **78.7** (Elevated).  
2. **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – same 52‑week lead, risk **78.7** (Elevated).

4. **STM32G431CBT6** – 52‑week lead, risk **77.1** (Elevated).  
5. **MT40A1G16TB-062E:F** – 52‑week lead, risk **76.8** (Elevated), price +4,655 % vs target.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 78.7 % chance of rise; expected **+7 %** (80 % range ‑4.4 % → +18.5 %); model‑based edge tested.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 65.9 % chance of rise; expected **+14 %** (‑0.6 % → +28.8 %); tested edge.

- **Fab utilization, next 6 mo:** 54.3 % chance of tighter supply; expected **+1.0 pts** (‑3.3 → +5.4 pts); trend‑following baseline.

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock‑in volume discounts** on the five logic parts with 52‑week lead times; suppliers will value guaranteed demand amid capacity strain.  
2. **Request price‑freeze clauses** for the Infineon MOSFET and any other parts flagged “Lock pricing” to hedge the 73 % upside risk.
